div.l: His palfray was broun̄ as a berye
¶ A Frere ther was also a wantone anda mery
A lymytoure a full solempne man̄
In alle theorders foure ys none that kan̄
So myche of dalyauns and fayre langage
He had made full many a maryage
Of yonge wōmmen at his own̄ coste
Vn to his order he was a nobull poste
Full welbyloued and famulyer was he
With Francleyn̄s oủer alle in his cuntre
And with worthy wōmmen of the tonū
For he had power of confessyonū
As he seyd hym selfe more þan A curate
For his order he was lycencyat
Full swetely herd he confessyoıı̄un
And plesaunt was his absolucyoıı̄un
He was an esy man̄ to yeve penance
There as he wyste to haue a gode pytanūs
For vn to a pore order for to yeve
Ys signe þat a man̄ ys well schryve
For yf he yaffe he durst make avaun̄t
That he wyste þat man̄ full repentaun̄t
For many a man̄ so harde ys herte
He may not wepe althouȝe hym sore smert
Therfore in stede of wepyng and prayers
Men̄ mot yeve syluer to þe pore Freres
Hys Typet was ay fassed full of knyves
And pynnes for to yeve fayre wyves
And certeynly he hade a mery note
Well cowde he synge and pley on the rote
Of such thyngꝭes bare he utterly þe pirise
